# iPrice Malaysia

> > iPrice Malaysia is a deals and promo code aggregator connecting consumers with discounts across travel, food delivery, fashion, and lifestyle brands in Malaysia.

The platform curates vouchers, coupons, and promotional offers from major brands including Malaysia Airlines, AirAsia, foodpanda, Domino's Pizza, Pizza Hut, Klook, Booking.com, and fashion retailers like Charles & Keith. iPrice helps Malaysian shoppers save money on flights, hotels, food delivery, and retail purchases through exclusive discount codes and limited-time deals.

## Key Topics

- Travel deals and flight discounts
- Food delivery promotions
- Malaysia Airlines MHexplorer offers
- AirAsia promo codes
- Hotel and accommodation discounts
- foodpanda vouchers
- Pizza deals (Domino's, Pizza Hut)
- Fashion and accessories discounts
- Car rental vouchers
- New user exclusive offers
- Trip.com and Klook tour deals
- Booking.com hotel promotions
- Charles & Keith fashion deals
- Duty-free shopping discounts
